items.how: Cash count certificate; daily cash-balance report from books.
steps: Count cash at year end in the presence of the cashier
Agree the count with the cash book
Run the daily cash-balance report and check for any negative balance
items.text: Cash physically counted at year end; no negative cash balance on any day.

items.how: BRS for all accounts; bank confirmations.
steps: Obtain bank reconciliations for all accounts at year end
Trace reconciling items to subsequent bank statements
Follow up stale cheques and entries pending over 3 months
items.text: Bank reconciliations reviewed; stale cheques and long-pending items followed up.

steps: Obtain the debtors' ageing
Test the provision / ECL against the ageing and recoveries
Check receipts after year end for large balances
items.text: Debtors' ageing reviewed; provision / expected credit loss adequate; subsequent receipts checked.

steps: Obtain the creditors' ageing
Identify MSME creditors from the vendor master
Agree the MSME disclosure figures with the ageing
items.text: Creditors' ageing prepared; MSME dues separately disclosed.

items.how: Valuation sheet; NRV test; non-moving list.
steps: Obtain the inventory valuation sheet
Test cost (purchase invoices / cost sheets) and NRV (post-year-end sale prices)
Identify slow-moving and obsolete items and check the provision
items.text: Inventory valued at lower of cost and net realisable value; slow-moving and obsolete items provided.

items.how: Fixed asset register; invoices; depreciation workings.
steps: Vouch a sample of additions to invoices and capitalisation approval
Recompute depreciation for a sample using Schedule II lives
Consider impairment indicators
items.text: Additions vouched, capitalisation criteria met, depreciation per Schedule II rates or useful lives, impairment considered.

items.how: Cut-off test of last and first invoices.
steps: Select the last invoices before and first invoices after year end
Check goods despatched / services rendered in the correct period
Record cut-off errors
items.text: Revenue recognised in the correct period; cut-off tested both sides of year end.

steps: Vouch a sample of expenses to bills and approvals
Check prepaid and outstanding items at year end
Review the provisions schedule
items.text: Expenses vouched; prepaid and outstanding items and provisions recognised correctly.

items.how: Sanction letters; lender confirmations; covenant test.
steps: Agree loan balances to lender statements and sanction letters
Check the current / non-current split
Test covenants and note any breach
items.text: Loans agree to sanction letters and lender statements; current/non-current split correct; covenant breaches checked.

steps: Review the current tax computation
Recompute deferred tax on timing / temporary differences
Agree tax balances to returns and challans
items.text: Current tax provision and deferred tax computed and reconciled.

items.ref: AS 15 / Ind AS 19; Code on Social Security 2020
steps: Obtain the actuarial report for gratuity and leave
Check the data given to the actuary (employees, salary)
Review the wage-component analysis for the Labour Codes
items.text: Gratuity and leave encashment provided on actuarial basis; effect of the Labour Codes' wage definition considered.

steps: Compare the related-party disclosure with the transaction register
Check balances outstanding at year end
Confirm the disclosure is complete
items.text: Related-party disclosures complete and match the transaction register.

steps: List guarantees, pending cases and tax demands
Agree with legal confirmations and portal orders
Check disclosure and any provision needed
items.text: Contingent liabilities and commitments disclosed (guarantees, pending cases, tax demands).

steps: Obtain the lease register and agreements
Check accounting under AS 19 / Ind AS 116
Check the disclosures
items.text: Leases accounted for and disclosed correctly.

steps: List foreign-currency monetary items at year end
Restate at closing rates and check the exchange difference
Check accounting treatment
items.text: Foreign currency items restated at closing rates; exchange differences treated correctly.

steps: Run the Schedule III additional-disclosure checklist
Check ageing schedules, ratios with explanations and title deeds
Confirm the benami, wilful defaulter, struck-off company and crypto disclosures
items.text: Additional Schedule III disclosures made: ageing schedules, ratios, title deeds not in company's name, benami property, wilful defaulter, struck-off companies, crypto, undisclosed income.

items.how: Review of journal entries tagged prior period.
steps: Scan journals for items tagged prior period
Check correction under AS 5 / Ind AS 8
Check disclosure of changes in policy
items.text: Prior period errors and changes in accounting policy identified and disclosed.
